primary.title: P/E vs PEG ratio: Which metric offers deeper insight into a company's growth potential and valuation?
primary.summary: The price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio is one of the most common metrics for valuing a stock. By incorporating earnings growth, the PEG ratio provides a more comprehensive view of whether a stock is fairly valued relative to its earnings growth.
